name: Guildfall Heroes
summary:
Guildfall Heroes is a tactical turn-based RPG focused on team building, positioning, and character progression. Players recruit heroes from different classes, equip them with weapons, armor and gems, and deploy their chosen party in grid-based battles where movement, attack range, elemental matchups and defensive tactics all matter.

Outside combat, players can expand their roster, complete quests, manage equipment through the Armory and Blacksmith, trade items with other players, and improve their heroes over time. Battles reward careful positioning and prediction, with mechanics such as Guard Stance, guarded cells, ranged attacks and class-specific abilities creating different tactical approaches.

Guildfall Heroes combines RPG progression with compact strategy battles designed around building a team and adapting it to different opponents.
